notes: Phase 2 of Title Multi-Touch Intercept fix: implemented cancelPendingInteraction() on TitleInteraction and onGestureStart callback on MultiTouchHandler, wired them together in createCollageLifecycle. When finger 1 touches title area and finger 2 starts a pinch/pan gesture, the onGestureStart callback fires and cancels the pending title drag state, preventing title movement during multi-touch gestures. Added 6 unit tests for cancelPendingInteraction (2.2.1-2.2.6), 4 unit tests for onGestureStart (2.3.1-2.3.3 + touch pointer), and 5 integration tests for cross-handler coordination (2.1.1-2.1.5). Fixed test 2.2.4 which needed setPointerCapture mocked. All 1752 tests pass across 52 test files.
